page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: a narrow strip of margin notes at the outer edge, mostly cut off and not legible enough to transcribe in full. Right page: one column of running text with a running head at the top, the page number at the top right, and a gathering signature at the foot. No notes in the right margin.

main_text.p: Δούλ© ω ὁ fervus. δούλη ης ἡ ancilla. Adjectivè etiam capitur Rom.6.19. τὰ μέλη δοῦλα membra serva.

Δουλόω ῶ fervum facio, in fervitutem redigo. Fut. ώσω. P. δεδουλωκα. aor.1. ἐδούλωσα. praef. paff. δουλόομαι ἕιμι fervus fio. P.paff. δεδού-λωμαι. part.prat. paff. δεδουλωμένος in fer-vitutem redactus, mancipatus. aor.1. paff. ἐδουλώθην. part. aor.1. paff. δουλωθεὶς ἐντῷ ὁ, Rom.6.22. δουλωθέντες τῷ Θεῷ, fervi facti Deo.
Δοχὴ ης ἡ epulum, convivium. à δέχομαι recipio, excipio, Luc.14.13.

Δράκων οντος ὁ draco, ferpentis fpecies. δέρκω video. Fut. δέρξω. a.2. ἐδράκον per metathesin ἐδρακον vidi. part. aor.2. δρακὼν ὀντος ὁ accentus mutatur differentia causa. Et hinc (ab acumine visus) hoc monstrum dictum esse volunt, Apoc.12.3.

Δράσσομαι vel Attice δράττομαι carpo. cum accuf. 1.Cor.2. apprehendo cum desiderio, cum genit. Fut. δράξομαι. aor.1. ἐδραξάμην, Psal.2.13. δράξασθε (2.pl.a.1. med. imperat.) πυγδίας. P.paff. δεδραγμαι. δράγμα τος τὸ manipulus, Deut.24.19.
Δραχμὴ ης ἡ drachma, Luc.15.8. à δράττομαι prehendo, unde δραξ ακος ὁ pugillus, id est, quantum pugno comprehendi potest. Idem quod δίωδελον ὁ τὸ, vide suprà.
Δρέπανον ὁ τὸ falx. per metonymiam messor,

page.notes: The left page is almost entirely cut off at the scan edge; only fragments of its margin notes survive (e.g. references such as "1 Pet.2.21" and "Ioan" fragments), too incomplete to transcribe reliably. Greek passages are transcribed from a low-contrast scan; accents and some letters are uncertain and may need checking. The running head is set partly in Greek capitals and is uncertain.
